name: The Domovoi
source:
Your friend, a folk storyteller, has offered to perform her latest work. As her audience, it is your task to advise how her tale should unfold.

[From [url=https://bravemule.itch.io/domovoi]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的朋友，一位民间故事讲述者，提出要表演她的最新作品。作为她的观众，你的任务是建议她的故事如何展开。

[来自[url=https://bravemule.itch.io/domovoi]Itch.io[/url]]
